steps.text: In a medium bowl, toss together cucumbers, red onion, and tomato. Gently stir in mayonnaise, vinegar, salt, and pepper until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Refreshing Cucumber Salad
raw_recipe.description: This cucumber salad is a quick-and-easy, throw-together salad that is both tangy and creamy. It's a refreshing way to use up some of your fresh garden veggies! Increase or decrease the amount of vinegar and mayonnaise to your liking.
raw_recipe.name: Refreshing Cucumber Salad

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium bowl, toss together cucumbers, red onion, and tomato. Gently stir in mayonnaise, vinegar, salt, and pepper until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

review.reviewBody: This is a good salad, but to prevent it from getting runny I always let the thin sliced cucumbers marinate in the vinegar (2 tbsp.) along with the salt and red onion for about an hour then drain it. I add the rest of the ingredients and let it chill for another hour.

OMG!! This is the exact same salad my Grandma used to make. Thank you! I could never get the amounts right and this was perfect! However, I did make some changes due to personal taste as well as what was on hand. 
I made a Quadruple batch so I used 4 large cukes, 2 md white onions, 5 Roma tomatoes, 1 cup mayo, 4 Tbl white vinegar, 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp pepper and 1 tsp minced garlic. I highly suggest that you whisk the dressing stuff first...then pour over the veggies and carefully stir. Otherwise it's not going to mix very well, and it absolutely must sit for AT LEAST 1-2 hours before eating, plus this is even better the next day, as the flavors then have enough time to truly blend and set, especially after the water is pulled from the tomatoes (which is what some people think is "runny", but that is actually your "dressing" so don't drain it! It has all your flavors in it!). I must say though, you absolutely have to check/taste the cukes for wax if you buy from a grocery store. If you can't wash all the wax off, then you must peel them completely, or your salad will be extremely bitter.
I let the cucumbers,onions and salt marinate for about 45 minutes beforehand. Make sure you drain before adding tomato and mayo. A little garlic powder and dill made this an excellent summer salad.

I loved this recipe! I followed the advice about marinating the cucumber, onion and salt in 2 tbsp vinegar for one hour, then draining and adding the remaining ingredients - 1 tbsp olive oil mayo and 1 tbsp light sour cream. The cucumber stayed nice and crisp, unlike other recipes I've tried. Highly recommended!

I was very nervous making this because I was making it for a physician I work with who described a cucumber salad he wanted for the semi-retirement lunch we were having for him. I used red onion as he requested and added a little sugar to the dressing so it would not be too tart. He was thrilled and everyone else loved it as well, including my daughter who had some of the leftovers! I should add that I sprinkled the sliced cucumbers with salt and vinegar and let it sit for an hour to draw out the water, rinsed them off them dried them between paper towels before actually making the recipe (and by "dry" I mean pressed them firmly). I was worried the salad would be runny since I was making it the night before, but this process worked great, and the salad was crispy and not runny at all.

Very delicious! I salted the cucumbers in a separate dish for about an hour, rinsed, patted dry. While the cucumbers were doing their thing, I mixed the dressing (I used 1 Tbls sour cream and 2 Tbls mayo) , added some dill, poured it over the red onions and tomatoes and waited for the cucumbers to be ready. Then added them to everything and it was yummy!

Delicious. I have made a marinated cucumber and onion salad with mostly vinegar and a little olive oil and prepared mustard for years. This was a nice change. I did, however, use red wine vinegar this time; but white vinegar would have been fine. This recipe goes well with spicy Indian dishes. It's just a great side dish for whatever. Thanks for sharing. UPDATE: I made this recently and added a couple tablespoons low fat sour cream. Increased the white vinegar to 1/3 cup. Sprinkled a little garlic powder, added 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice and a sprinkle of dry dill. Family raved about it.

Hubs said this one is a keeper. I followed some reviewers suggestion to salt the sliced cukes (put a weight on them) for 30 minutes and drained the resulting water. Used a portion of sour cream for part of the mayonnaise and added some dill. Nice summer treat.

This was really good. I usually don't like cucumber salads, but I loved this one. I added about 1/4 tsp. of sugar to the dressing and I didn't put the tomatoes in until I served it. This prevented the dressing from getting too runny. I also made it without the tomato and it was just as delicious!
Really good, quick and easy too. For the vinegar I used 1/2 balsamic and 1/2 white, plus 1 Tbsp EVO. Even better the next day.

I loved this recipe! I took the advice of soaking the cucumbers, red onion, and salt in the vinegar, and then drain it. It worked perfect. I used the cherry tomatoes from my garden plants and I think it worked better than a whole tomato would. Also, I used roughly one and a half tablespoons of salad dressing and one and a half tablespoons of sour cream and it was simply delicious. Definitely one I would make again.
used thinly sliced yellow peppers instead if tomato for a different taste
Great recipe! I needed a salad recipe to go with the other foods on my diet, and this salad hits the spot.

Super good! Really fresh and great for my diet. Best I've tasted! Didn't use all the right ingredients but I think it tastes lovely. I used the ingredients to taste which I just plopped some in the bowl and kept tasting. I used a large cucumber and yellow onion.
Great salad with a bit of tang. I also make it & let it refrigerate then pour it over chopped lettuce & serve as a regular salad.
Refreshing Cucumber Salad by ShawnaRae. Subbed w red wine vinegar. Typical, but good.
Very refreshing! I omitted the mayo and added red wine vinegar instead. Everyone really enjoyed the flavor.
I made the salad without making any changes and it was super good!I made this for my family and I and we all loved it.I look forward to making it again!
It is one of the best salads I have eaten in my life. It is truly refreshing! Try adding 2 more tablespoons of mayo and it will be the perfect salad!
Awesome! I added 2 tablespoons of water also because I used more onions and cucumbers than the recipe called for. Turned out great! Thank you
